literal_meaning: ভূতের ঘাড়ে চাপা দেওয়া (ghost pressing on the neck)
figurative_meaning_en: To incite or encourage mischievous or evil intentions
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে তার ভাইকে ভূত চাপা দিয়ে খারাপ কাজে উস্কানি দিল।
এই বন্ধু তো সবসময় ভূত চাপা দেয়, কখনো ভালো কথা বলে না।
example_sentences_in_english: He put a ghost on his brother's neck by inciting him to do something naughty.
This friend always eggs on bad ideas, like a ghost pressing on the neck.
history: This idiom draws from Bengali folklore where 'bhoot chapa' describes sleep paralysis or nocturnal visitations by spirits, metaphorically extended to influencing someone towards wrongdoing.
note: The idiom reflects common Bengali beliefs in ghosts and spirits affecting human behavior.
